The king must comply with the Quran and Sharia law, and tribal sheikhs hold a degree of influence over local and national events. Open protest against the government is not tolerated, although terrorism by opposition Islamic sects has taken place in recent years. Saudi Arabia's economy is driven by oil, which accounts for about 75% of its budget revenues and 90% of its exports.
